sporeRim.rationale: Warm Cayfen masonry and daylight transition into a root-filled abyss; open causeway and central sign landing are legible. The small western stair is grounded and the central stele blocks passage. Source grid overlays, phone day/night and desktop comparisons inspected; connectivity audited separately.
